answers.core: It's a change internal to the `OptionButton` class.
answers.workaround:
I've been working in C#, so I'm not sure if this applies to GDScript, but I was able to work around this by manually emitting the signal after setting the value.

`optionButton.EmitSignal(OptionButton.SignalName.ItemSelected, optionButton.Selected);`

However, it's very strange `OptionButton` is the only instance I've found that does not emit the signal itself. This will likely confuse another person not aware of this unique behavior.

title: OptionButton: Emit item_selected when selected is changed via script
